title: Find female patients older than 60 years who have both low albumin levels (
question: Find female patients older than 60 years who have both low albumin levels (<3.5) and elevated total cholesterol (≥250). For each qualifying lab test, return the patient ID, sex, diagnosis, and test date.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
       P."XCL_058",
       P."XCL_059",
       P."XCL_064",
       L."XCL_015"
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L
  ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060")) > 60
  AND L."XCL_031" < 3.5
  AND L."XCL_026" >= 250
